payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance metrics comparing the SubGram model to the Skip-gram model, indicating the gains obtained from using the SubGram model.

claims.text: The SubGram model significantly outperforms the Skip-gram model with a performance of 22.4% compared to 9.7%.
The SubGram model performs similarly to the Skip-gram model on morpho-syntactic question sets, achieving 42.5% versus 42.3%.
